post.summary: Idempotently ensure the caller has the standard calendar set; returns it.

get.summary: Per-contact participation across your readable calendars (contactId, item count, most recent occurrence start), ordered most-interacted first. Optional from/to restricts the window. A ranking signal for contact pickers/resolvers.
List the calendars the caller can access.

post.summary: Create a calendar. (Address books are managed by LupiraContactApi.)
Grant a member access to a calendar (access = owner|read-write|read; default owner).

delete.summary: Revoke a member's access to a calendar (by email). 409 if it would remove the last owner.

get.summary: Search calendar items (text + tag + parent + attendee contact + category/status filter; recurrence expanded in-window). Text queries and parent/contact filters with no from/to match all-time; otherwise the window defaults to ±1 year. skip/take page over occurrences sorted by start (desc=true for newest first). Only items accepted into a calendar you can read.

post.summary: Create a calendar item (filed into CalendarId if given, else unfiled for later curation). A location must be a resolved PlaceId (free text is CalDAV-only).

get.summary: Get a single calendar item.

put.summary: Update a calendar item. Plain fields: omitted = kept; fields paired with a *Provided sentinel are written verbatim when it is true (enables clearing recurrence, switching all-day, editing timezones). Offline clients send Idempotency-Key (their command id) + body OccurredAt for replay-safe, last-writer-wins updates.

delete.summary: Delete a calendar item (soft delete + tombstone). A replay bearing the same Idempotency-Key succeeds instead of 404ing.

get.summary: Calendar items anchored to a LupiraGeoApi place (its location, or a travel endpoint). Only items in a calendar you can read.

post.summary: Merge arbitrary JSON metadata into a calendar item. Offline clients pass ?occurredAt= + Idempotency-Key for replay-safe, last-writer-wins merges.

put.summary: Set the LLM-interpreted payload on an item (server-side only; never in the export). 409 if the item carries an action.
Set the deterministic payload on an item (server-side only; never in the export). 409 if the item carries a prompt.

post.summary: Link a calendar item to an external reference (e.g. a LupiraTasks item, or an Activity-API engagement/project).

get.summary: List a calendar item's relations.

post.summary: Link many references of one kind to an item at once (idempotent per reference) — e.g. an album's photos to its event.
Unlink many references of one kind from an item at once (idempotent: references with no matching edge are ignored).

get.summary: Every edge of one kind the caller can see, with its item and reference — e.g. all photo links.

Places where your events and photos concentrate, derived at read time and ranked by active days (distinct UTC days with an event occurrence or a photo). Events come from calendars you can read (or calendarId), photos are your own. Defaults: all-time up to now, minDays 3, limit 100. A hotspot carries the LupiraGeoApi PlaceId it anchors to, else a reverse-geocoded label.
List items proposed into a calendar (awaiting accept/reject).

post.summary: Accept a proposed item into a calendar. Offline clients pass ?occurredAt= + Idempotency-Key for replay-safe, last-writer-wins filing.
File an existing item into a calendar (status=proposed|accepted, default proposed). Offline clients pass ?occurredAt= + Idempotency-Key.

delete.summary: Remove an item from a calendar (reject / unfile). Offline clients pass ?occurredAt= + Idempotency-Key.

post.summary: Invite a contact (must be a Contact id). role = chair|req-participant|opt-participant|non-participant.
Record an RSVP. status = needs-action|accepted|declined|tentative|delegated.
Confirm attendance.
Record that the participant left.

get.summary: Delta feed for offline mirrors: everything the caller can read that changed past the cursor, plus tombstone ids for items deleted or no longer visible. Omit since for a full sync (tombstones suppressed — replace the mirror wholesale); loop while hasMore, persisting cursor between calls.
Snapshot of the caller's calendars for mirror reconciliation. Containers are plain documents with no event history (no cursor) — fetch once per sync cycle and diff locally.
The caller's resolved local identity (JIT-provisioned on first login).

post.summary: Idempotently ensure the caller has a personal address book; returns all accessible books.

put.summary: Link the caller's identity to its own contact ("this card is me") — the default focus for contact circles.

get.summary: List the address books the caller can access.

post.summary: Create an address book; the caller becomes its owner.

put.summary: Rename an address book or change its display name (owner only; merge — omitted fields are kept).

delete.summary: Delete an empty address book (owner only). 409 if it still holds contacts or groups, or is the personal book.

get.summary: List who has access to an address book and at what level (owner only).

post.summary: Grant a member access to an address book (access = owner|read-write|read; default owner).

delete.summary: Revoke a member's access to an address book (by email). 409 if it would remove the last owner.

get.summary: Search contacts (full-text + fuzzy name match).

post.summary: Create a contact.

get.summary: Get a single contact.

put.summary: Update a contact (merge — provided fields overwrite/append, unmentioned fields are kept).

get.summary: Computed social circles (close family, extended family, friends, colleagues, household) around a focus contact — the caller's own linked contact unless focusId overrides. Degree is a closeness bucket (1 immediate, 2 two-generation kin, 3 cousin). Ended relations are excluded.

put.summary: Mark a contact as deceased (idempotent; the date may be unknown). Deceased contacts stay in the kinship graph — death is not deletion.

delete.summary: Undo a deceased marking recorded in error. (CardDAV can set but never clear deceased — clearing is API-only.)

put.summary: Replace the contact's social/IM handles wholesale. Service names are canonicalized; well-known services (telegram, messenger, whatsapp…) get the profile URL derived from the handle. At most one preferred handle per service.
Replace the contact's postal addresses wholesale; each entry needs a LupiraGeoApi place id (resolve the address there first — no free-text).
Replace the contact's emergency-contact designation wholesale (order = priority, empty clears). A designation, not a relation kind — your emergency contact is usually also a spouse or friend.

Replace the contact's reach channels (emails + phones) wholesale (empty clears). Unlike the merge update, this can remove a channel; values are trimmed, type tokens lowercased, duplicates dropped, at most one preferred per medium.
Replace the contact's tags wholesale (empty clears). Unlike the merge update, this can remove a tag; entries are trimmed and de-duplicated case-insensitively.

get.summary: Resolved relations, both directions: each entry's kind is the other contact's role relative to this one (incoming = derived inverse). Set includeInferred=true to also return kin derived from the parent/child graph (siblings, grandparents/-children, aunts/uncles, cousins, nieces/nephews), tagged Provenance=Inferred.

post.summary: Upsert a relation: 'toContactId is this contact's kind' (re-adding the same target+kind revises the label).

delete.summary: Remove the relation edge to a contact with the given kind — for edges entered by mistake. A relationship that ran its course should be ended instead.

post.summary: Mark a relation as ended (ex-spouse, falling-out): the edge stays, flagged with an optional end date, and no longer asserts current kinship. Re-adding the same relation revives it.

get.summary: List groups (personal groupings + organizations) in an address book.

post.summary: Create a group. kind = group|organization (an employer is an organization-kind group).
Add a contact to a group; for an organization, role is the title held there (re-adding updates it).

delete.summary: Remove a contact from a group.

get.summary: Delta feed for offline mirrors: every contact the caller can read that changed past the cursor, plus tombstone ids for contacts deleted or no longer visible (incl. moved to an unreadable address book). Omit since for a full sync; loop while hasMore, persisting cursor between calls.
Snapshot of the caller's address books + contact groups for mirror reconciliation (no cursor — fetch once per sync cycle and diff locally).

Search the gazetteer: text (q, trigram), category/kind, containment (withinAreaId), curation state (hasCoordinates/source/verified — hasCoordinates=false lists unlocated stubs), and spatial — proximity (nearLat+nearLon[+radiusM], returns distanceM) or viewport (bbox=minLon&bbox=minLat&bbox=maxLon&bbox=maxLat).

post.summary: Create a user place directly (name + optional coordinates/category).

get.summary: Typeahead: trigram-ranked suggestions over places (names + aliases) and AdminArea localities, discriminated by type.
The append-only curation log for a place, oldest first. Readable for tombstoned/merged places; 404 only for unknown ids.
A single place with its aliases, external ids, and containment chain (outermost→innermost). Follows merge redirects.

patch.summary: Curate a place: rename, recategorize, or verify.

post.summary: Re-geocode a place from its address/name and attach coordinates, containment, and OSM id — heals a coordinate-less stub or refreshes a stale fix. force=true bypasses and overwrites the frozen geocode cache (heals a frozen empty answer). 400 on a no-hit or transient geocoder outage; the place is left unchanged.

Bulk get-by-ids (max 200) — hydrate stored place ids into coordinates in one call. Responses align index-for-index; a null place means unknown or deleted, a merged id returns the survivor. Containment is omitted (use GET /places/{id} for detail).

Create/dedupe a place from one specific forward-geocode hit the user picked (query + OSM identity). Reuses the frozen geocode cache — no extra geocoder call. 400 if the hit is not among the query's geocode results.

get.summary: Live places nothing references — cross-checked against contact addresses, calendar items (live + deleted counted separately), and saved places. Fails 400 when a reference source is unreachable (never declares orphans on partial data).

post.summary: Soft-delete orphan places (max 100 per call). References are re-checked per id at prune time; a place referenced since the find returns Referenced and is left alone. Places referenced only by soft-deleted calendar items are never pruned here — use DELETE /places/{id} to override.

get.summary: Text → candidate coordinates + structured address (cached).
The caller's saved places / personal labels (favorites first).
Get a list with its members and tags (Viewer+).
Search items across the caller's lists (Viewer+).
get.description: Case-insensitive `query` title substring, optional `completed`/`status`. `dueFrom`/`dueTo` bound `dueAt` half-open `[from, to)`; either bound implies `dueAt` is set. Spans every list the caller is a member of (archived included).

get.summary: Get a single item (Viewer+).

post.summary: Reparent / reorder an item (Editor+).
post.description: Carries the fractional-index `sortOrder` string and optional `parentItemId`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated GUIDv7 command id. A redelivery with the same key is a no-op that returns the prior result (offline-safe retry).

post.summary: Link a task to a cal-api Prompt heartbeat or an external ref (Editor+).
post.description: Body `{ toKind, toRef, relationType, metadata? }`. `toKind` e.g. `cal-item` (the checking heartbeat Prompt) or `url` (issue/PR/incident/release). `relationType` e.g. `monitors`, `spawned-by`, `produced`, `blocked-by`, `relates-to`. Idempotent: re-linking the same edge is a no-op.

post.summary: Register a device; returns the one-time ingest API key.

delete.summary: Retire a device (revokes its ingest keys).

get.summary: Latest known location per device.
Server-downsampled track (one best-accuracy fix per time bucket).
Materialized stay-points over a time range.
Materialized trips over a time range.

delete.summary: Purge raw fixes + derived docs in a time range (owner erase).

post.summary: Declare an asset (idempotent) and receive a presigned upload URL while bytes are pending.

get.summary: List assets (keyset-paged, newest taken first by default) with presigned thumbnail URLs. trashed=true lists only the trash.

post.summary: Verify the uploaded bytes and queue processing (idempotent).
Re-queue a Ready or Failed asset through the processing pipeline.
Move an asset to the trash (idempotent). It keeps its bytes and status until restored or purged.
Take an asset back out of the trash (idempotent).
Hydrate up to 200 assets by id — turns relation references into renderable items.

get.summary: Library totals and counts by kind, status, geotag source and month.
Imported event folders and albums with their core date span, for linking to calendar events.
Place labels by asset count, most used first — suggestions for the place filter (q = substring).
Geotagged Ready assets in a viewport as GeoJSON: a point per photo when at most 200 are in view or zoom >= 17, else a point per grid cell with its count.
One asset with presigned original + thumbnail URLs.

patch.summary: Hand-set metadata (the photographer); outranks anything derived.

delete.summary: Delete an asset permanently, trashed or not: objects first, then the document.

get.summary: Hybrid research search over the corpus (semantic + full-text, reranked).
List topics by status and/or contact (poll alternative to closed-topic push).
Get a topic with its ordered message window (open-topic tail).

Access.description: A principal's permission on a collection. `Owner` adds member-management + delete rights over `ReadWrite`.

ActionKind.description: A deterministic, no-LLM action executed directly at fire time.

label.description: Free-text refinement of the kind, e.g. "dad".

since.description: When the relationship began, if a precise date is known.

note.description: Free-text note about the edge (how/where it started); fuzzy periods that aren't a precise date go here.

AddContactRelationRequest.description: Upserts a directed relation edge on a contact: "Guid AddContactRelationRequest.ToContactId is this contact's ContactRelationKind AddContactRelationRequest.Kind".

AddressBookDto.description: An address book the caller can access, with their access level.

AdminAreaDto.description: A node in the administrative containment tree (Country/Region/Locality).

AdminLevel.description: Level of an AdminArea in the containment tree (Locality → Region → Country).

conversationId.description: The thread the message belongs to — the jump target for the archive browser.

conversationTitle.description: The thread the message belongs to, if titled.

score.description: The cross-encoder relevance score from the rerank pass (higher = more relevant).

ArchiveSearchHitDto.description:
One corpus message returned by research search (`archive_search`), ordered by the
            reranker's relevance. Read-only projection over the `comms` corpus — never a whole topic.

AvailabilityStatus.description: A presence/availability segment's status. A day may hold several segments (whole-day or timed).

BookingDetail.description:
A reservation/confirmation attached to any category (a booked meal, a ticketed outing, a hotel, a flight).
            `ProviderContactId` reuses a `Contact` (airline, hotel, restaurant, venue); `PartySize` covers a
            table/seat reservation; `Amount`/`Currency` the paid cost.

CalendarEntryStatus.description: Curation state of a CalendarItem within a calendar. `Removed` is retained as a sync tombstone.

oneOf.description: Event-bound payload (server-side only; never in ICS). At most one of ItemPrompt? CalendarItemDto.Prompt/ItemAction? CalendarItemDto.Action is set.
How well-documented this item is (null = not applicable, e.g. exempt kinds/calendars). Drives Elicit ranking.

createdAt.description:
Server-side timestamps (from the event timeline) + stream version — the ordering/versioning
            surface offline clients key on. `Etag` stays content-derived and is orthogonal.

calendarIds.description: Accepted calendar memberships, limited to calendars the caller can read.

parentItemId.description: Hierarchy link (e.g. the trip a leg belongs to). Title only when the caller can read the parent.

childCount.description: Direct children visible to the caller, independent of the current filters.

oneOf.description: The item's own completeness (same across its occurrences; null = not applicable), so search results rank directly.
Provenance of a read-time-projected occurrence (e.g. Birthdays → a contact). Null for stored items.

CalendarItemOccurrenceDto.description: A single concrete occurrence of an item within a search window (recurrences expanded).

CircleKind.description: An inferred social cohort around a focus contact (computed on read, never stored).

CircleMemberDto.description:
`Degree` is a pragmatic closeness bucket (1 = immediate, 2 = two-generation kin, 3 = cousin), not
        consanguinity. `Kind` is null when the membership makes no kinship claim (household co-residency).

CompletenessGap.description: A field the record is missing or thin on, with its rubric weight (heavier = ask first).

CompletenessScore.description:
How well-documented a record is: `Score` 0..1 (Σ weight·presence / Σ weight), the unmet
            fields ranked by missing mass (weight·absence, largest first), and the rubric version that produced it.
            `null` (not this type) means "not applicable".

ContactAddressType.description: Type of a contact's postal address.

ContactCirclesDto.description:
Computed social circles around a focus contact. Always contains every CircleKind, possibly empty;
            a contact may appear in several circles.

avatarRef.description: Pointer to an avatar image (URL/media id), never bytes.

emergencyContactIds.description: Ordered designation (first = highest priority) — who to call about this person, not a kinship.

relations.description: Raw outgoing edges (unfiltered; targets may be deleted or unreadable). The `/relations` sub-resource is the resolved two-way view.

oneOf.description: How well-documented this contact is. Drives contact-enrichment ranking (completeness × relevance).

version.description: Stream version — the offline clients' optimistic-versioning surface (`Etag` stays content-derived).

ContactGroupDto.description: A contact group (personal grouping or organization) and its current members.

ContactGroupKind.description: A personal grouping (Friends/Family/Colleagues) vs a company/institution. An employer is membership in an `Organization`-kind group.

ContactKind.description:
What the contact card represents — vCard `KIND`. A business/venue (a provider referenced from
            bookings, say) is an `Organization`: no birthday, employer, or kinship applies. `Individual` is ordinal 0
            so pre-existing events replay as persons.

ContactOwnerGrantDto.description: The result of granting a member access to a container: who now has what access on which container.

ContactPostalAddress.description:
A contact's postal address: a LupiraGeoApi place id (the sole source of truth — no free-text) with a home/work
            type. FuzzyDate boundaries are as precise as actually known, null = unknown; currency is
            bool ContactPostalAddress.IsActiveOn(DateOnly today), never "MovedOut set".

ContactReachChannel.description:
A way to reach a contact — an email address or phone number — with an open string? ContactReachChannel.Type token
            (well-known: home/work/cell/fax/pager/other) and a per-medium bool ContactReachChannel.Preferred flag. A record so event
            payloads stay immutable.

ContactRelationDto.description:
One outgoing relation edge as published: "the `ToContactId` contact is my `Kind`".
            `Ended`/`Until` mark a relationship that ran its course, distinct from removal.

since.description: When the relationship began, on outgoing edges where a precise date is known.

note.description: Free-text note about the edge, on outgoing edges.

ended.description: The relationship ran its course (ex-spouse); the edge remains for history but asserts no current kinship.

ContactRelationEntryDto.description:
One resolved relation as seen from the viewed contact: ContactRelationKind ContactRelationEntryDto.Kind is always the OTHER contact's role
            relative to the viewed one (incoming edges show the derived inverse kind, and their label — the other side's phrasing — is omitted).
            RelationProvenance ContactRelationEntryDto.Provenance distinguishes stored edges from kin derived off the parent/child graph (returned only when inferred relations are requested).

ContactRelationKind.description:
Kind of a contact-to-contact edge: the related (To) contact's role relative to the owning contact ("To is my Kind").
            The extended-family kinds are storable for when the linking relative isn't a contact (a deceased parent, say); the same
            kinds are also produced by KinshipInference from the parent/child graph, distinguished on read by RelationProvenance.

ContactSectionGuardsDto.description:
Per-section guards for a contact. `Core` covers the whole ContactFields (name/channels/tags/
            notes… — channel and tag writes ride the same revision event); the rest map 1:1 to their write endpoints.

ContactSocialProfileDto.description:
A contact's social/IM handle as published. Service and handle are guaranteed non-empty —
            `SetProfilesAsync` rejects the write otherwise.

ContactSocialProfileInput.description:
A social/IM handle as submitted. `Url` is derived from the handle for well-known services when
            omitted; `Preferred` defaults to false.

ContactSyncChangeDto.description: A changed contact: the full DTO plus its section guards.

deleted.description:
Ids no longer visible to the caller: soft-deleted, or moved into an address book the caller
            can't read. Unknown ids are safe to ignore.

ContactSyncChangesResponse.description:
One page of the changes feed. `Cursor` is opaque — hand it back as `?since=`; loop while
            `HasMore`. A full sync (no `since`) streams every live visible contact; tombstone ids may reference
            contacts the client never saw (ignore unknown ids).

ContainerDto.description:
A calendar the caller can access; `access` is the caller's own grant level.
            `Class`/`Kind` classify the calendar. (Address books live in LupiraContactApi.)

CreateAddressBookRequest.description: Create an address book; the caller becomes its owner.

sourceKey.description:
Client-supplied provenance/idempotency key (e.g. an import `sourceKey`). When set, the item's stream id
            is derived from it (DeterministicGuid), so re-creating with the same key is a no-op
            that returns the existing item — safe batch/import replay. Also becomes the item's external UID. Omit for a random uid.

parentItemId.description: Nest this item under a parent (e.g. a trip's leg/sub-event). The parent must exist and be accessible to the caller.

parentSourceKey.description:
Alternative to Guid? CreateCalendarItemRequest.ParentItemId for batch imports: reference the parent by its string? CreateCalendarItemRequest.SourceKey;
            the server resolves it to the parent's deterministic id. Used when parent + children are created in one batch. Ignored if Guid? CreateCalendarItemRequest.ParentItemId is set.

location.description:
Free-text location resolved server-side to a LupiraGeoApi place (fail-closed if geo is up but can't resolve).
            Prefer Guid? CreateCalendarItemRequest.PlaceId when you have already resolved/vetted the place (places-first imports) — then string? CreateCalendarItemRequest.Location
            is used only as the display label.

placeId.description:
A pre-resolved LupiraGeoApi place id. When set, it is attached directly (no geocoding, no fail-closed risk) and
            string? CreateCalendarItemRequest.Location, if any, is kept as the label. Trust the caller resolved it via geo first.

oneOf.description:
Confidence of the start/end date for a historical or backfilled item — the date is still a concrete day;
            this records that it is only known to the month/year/roughly. Omit for exact dates.

Optional server-side annotations (e.g. import provenance) merged onto the item at creation — same store
            as `POST /items/{id}/metadata`, saving a second call. Never in ICS.
Sets the item's presence segment status (whole-day or timed via Starts/Ends) — availability lives on the availability calendar.
Composable detail: a `Booking` (any category) and/or a `Travel` leg (a `Trip`); Travel place refs are free-text labels.
Calendars only; defaults to Agenda/Generic. Ignored for address books.

sourceKey.description:
Client-chosen stable key that pins the contact's identity (offline clients mint a UUIDv7): a
            replayed create with the same key returns the existing contact instead of duplicating it.

oneOf.description: Individual (default) or Organization — a business/venue card that skips person-only enrichment.

CreateContactRequest.description:
Create a contact via REST/MCP. No `FullName` — the display name is composed from the structured parts.
            An employer is set separately as membership in an `organization`-kind contact group.

name.description: Canonical name override; defaults to the normalized query text.

CreatePlaceFromGeocodeRequest.description:
Create/dedupe a place from one specific forward-geocode hit the user picked, identified by OSM identity.
            The hit must be among the (cached) geocode results for string CreatePlaceFromGeocodeRequest.Query — the preview call froze them, so this
            costs no extra geocoder round trip.

CreatePlaceRequest.description: Create a user place directly (name + optional coordinates/category).

CreateRelationsBatchRequest.description: Many references of one kind linked to one item in a single call (e.g. an album's photos to its event).

CurationAction.description:
A curation decision recorded on a Place in the append-only `curation_log`. Stable names —
            they are the future event-type names, so never rename a member (add new ones; keep old ones readable).

CurationEventDto.description: One curation-log entry for a place. Readable for tombstoned/merged places too — that is the audit's point.

requiredHeaders.description: Headers the PUT must echo — they are part of the presigned signature.

DeclaredPhotoResponse.description:
Declare outcome. UploadUrl is present only while the asset still needs bytes (status
            Declared); an already-uploaded asset returns its status so the client skips the transfer.

capturedByContactId.description: The photographer's contact — the phone sends its owner's own contact.

DeclarePhotoRequest.description:
Client-side MediaStore metadata for one asset. (DeviceId, MediaStoreId) under the caller is
            the idempotency key — retrying a declare returns the same asset.

DeleteRelationsBatchRequest.description: Many references of one kind unlinked from one item in a single call (e.g. photos removed from an event's album).

DeviceKind.description: Kind of registered device that feeds location telemetry.

DisplayNameFormat.description: How a contact's DisplayName renders. Rendering-only — excluded from the content hash. `Full` is ordinal 0 so old events replay to today's behavior.

EndContactRelationRequest.description: Ends a relation (relationship ran its course — the edge stays, flagged). Removal is for edges entered by mistake.

ExternalScheme.description: External identity system a PlaceExternalId reconciles against.

FallbackMode.description: On a missed contract: retry once then ask (Retry), ask immediately (Ask), or drop (Drop).

FuzzyDate.description:
A date known to year, year-month, or full-day precision — the precision itself carries the certainty
            ("2015" means "sometime in 2015"). Used for residency boundaries on ContactPostalAddress.
            int FuzzyDate.Year is always present; int? FuzzyDate.Day requires int? FuzzyDate.Month. Distinct from
            PartialDate, which models the opposite case (year unknown, month-day known).

GapSeverity.description: A field is fully present, weak/partial (0.5), or absent.

osmType.description: OSM identity of the hit (e.g. "way" + 175761024) — the key for `POST /places/from-geocode`.

GeocodeResultDto.description:
A geocoding hit — a coordinate + display label + best-effort structured address and category. Coarse by
            design (coordinates are quantized to the cache grid).

GrantOwnerRequest.description:
Grant a member access to a container, identified by their login `Email` (provisioned if they have
            not logged in yet). `Access` is `owner` (default), `read-write`, or `read` — case-insensitive.

GroupMemberDto.description:
A contact's membership in a group. `Role` is the title held in an organization (null for personal
            groupings); `Since`/`Until` bound the tenure when known.

id.description: `place:{placeId}` when anchored, else `cell:{lat},{lon}` of its densest ~100 m cell.

radiusM.description: Distance from the centre to the farthest contributing point.

placeId.description: The LupiraGeoApi place the hotspot anchors to.

label.description: The anchor place's name, else a reverse-geocoded label.

activeDays.description: Distinct UTC days with an event or a photo here.

HotspotDto.description: A place where the caller's events and photos concentrate, derived at read time and ranked by active days.

ItemAction.description: A deterministic payload executed directly (no LLM). `ParamsJson` carries the frozen params (e.g. a SendCheckIn message).

ItemAttendeeDto.description: One attendee's participation, composed from the participation events.

ItemDetails.description:
Composable, category-independent detail for a CalendarItem: any of a reservation (BookingDetail? ItemDetails.Booking),
a movement leg (TravelLeg? ItemDetails.Travel, a `Trip` only), or an availability segment (PresenceDetail? ItemDetails.Presence). Each is
an optional value object rather than a per-kind member, so one event can carry several at once (a booked flight sets both
BookingDetail? ItemDetails.Booking and TravelLeg? ItemDetails.Travel). Location (venue, hotel, clinic) uses the item's `PlaceId`
(a LupiraGeoApi place id) + `LocationLabel`; provider/driver references reuse a `Contact` id.

ItemDetailsRequest.description:
Composable detail input for create/update. BookingDetail? ItemDetailsRequest.Booking (reservation/confirmation) attaches to any category;
TravelLegRequest? ItemDetailsRequest.Travel applies to a `Trip` (its `ToPlace`/`FromPlace` are free-text labels resolved to a
a LupiraGeoApi place, like `Location`). A presence/availability segment is authored via the request's top-level
`Availability` field, not here. On update, a supplied member replaces that member wholesale; omitted members are kept.

status.description: The lifecycle status; bool ItemDto.Completed is the derived `Status == Done` convenience.

oneOf.description: Who completed it; `null` if open, or a share-link/unresolved actor.
Who created it; `null` for a share-link/unresolved actor.
Free-form JSON for agent/server bookkeeping. Server-side only — never in VTODO or the public share DTO.

ItemDto.description: An item's current snapshot. Clients nest by Guid? ItemDto.ParentItemId.

ItemPrompt.description: An LLM-interpreted, contracted payload → an agent run. Declared at authoring time; enforced by assistant-api at fire time.

access.description:
The caller's own role on this list — server-authoritative, so clients gate owner/editor
            UI on this instead of matching themselves against IReadOnlyList<MemberDto> ListDto.Members.

sortOrder.description:
The caller's own position for this list (fractional-index key), or null if they have
            never reordered it — clients sort those by name, after the keyed ones. Nobody else's ordering
            is exposed.

archivedAt.description:
When the list was archived; null while active. Archived views sort on this rather than
            DateTimeOffset ListDto.UpdatedAt, which later edits bump.

ListDto.description: Full list metadata including members and tag definitions.

ListKind.description:
Drives client UI affordances (e.g. shopping lists surface quantity/unit), and distinguishes
            agent/system-owned lists from a user's own (ListKind.Agent) in queries and UI. A pure label set at
            creation (carried by `ListCreated`); ownership/membership still govern access.

ListRole.description: A member's authority on a list. Ordered: Owner > Editor > Viewer.

fromVisitId.description:
Endpoint visits (when the trip started/ended at a detected stay-point) — lets a client join trips to
            visit markers without time-window heuristics. The trip carries no geometry; fetch the polyline via
            GET /location/track/thinned for [StartTs, EndTs].

LookupPhotosRequest.description:
Hydrates a set of asset ids in one call — used to turn calendar-item relation references
            into renderable items.

LookupPlacesRequest.description:
Bulk get-by-ids (max 200) — hydrates place ids other services store (calendar items, contact addresses)
            into coordinates in one call. Duplicates are allowed; responses align index-for-index with the input.

contactId.description: The caller's own contact ("this card is me"), when linked — the default circles focus.

MeDto.description:
The resolved local identity of the caller: the stable Guid MeDto.PrincipalId plus current
            email/display name — the same identity shape (`principalId`/`email`/`displayName`) the
            platform uses everywhere it returns a person.

oneOf.description: Who added them; `null` for a share-link add or an unresolved actor.

MemberDto.description: A member of a list: the stable `PrincipalId` plus resolved `Email`/`DisplayName`.

MessageSource.description:
The connector/platform a message was captured from. Stored as a string (via
`JsonStringEnumConverter` on the wire, `text` in the corpus) so the value is stable
across reordering. Extends as connectors land (email, etc.).

occurredAt.description: Client wall-clock at the moment of the change (LWW key). Defaults to server now.

MoveItemRequest.description:
Reparent and/or reorder an item. string MoveItemRequest.SortOrder is a fractional-index
string so concurrent inserts get distinct keys without renumbering siblings.

OccurrenceOrigin.description:
Ties a projected occurrence back to the entity it was derived from — the birthday occurrence's
            Guid OccurrenceOrigin.SourceId is the contact whose birthday it is.

OriginKind.description: What a read-time-projected occurrence was synthesized from.

OrphanCandidateDto.description:
A live place nothing references: zero contact addresses, zero live calendar items, zero saved places.
            bool OrphanCandidateDto.Prunable is false when soft-deleted calendar items still reference it — an undelete would dangle.

OutputKind.description: The ProposedAction kind a run is contracted to yield (assistant-api validates against it; cal-api only stores it).

OwnerGrantDto.description: The result of granting a member access to a container: who now has what access on which container.

PartialDate.description:
A calendar date that may omit the year — a birthday is often known only as a month-day.
            int PartialDate.Month and int PartialDate.Day are always present; int? PartialDate.Year is null when unknown.
            Canonical text is `yyyy-MM-dd` with a year, else `--MM-dd` (a serialization concern; wire formats
            live at the seam, see VCardSerializer).

ParticipationSummaryEntry.description:
One contact's participation across the caller's readable calendars: how many items they attend(ed)
            and the most recent occurrence start (past or planned). A ranking signal for pickers/resolvers, not an ACL surface.

PersonRef.description: The canonical identity projection on the read boundary: the stable Guid PersonRef.PrincipalId (the key a client should store/compare) plus the current string PersonRef.Email and string? PersonRef.DisplayName for display. Every identity slot the API returns (owner, member, assignee, creator, completer, directory person) is a `PersonRef`; identity inputs stay email (invite/assign). Built from a resolved Principal.

source.description: The import source (`handelser`, `takeout`, …); null for phone assets.

folderDate.description: The date the folder name carries, when it has one.

coreFrom.description: The densest run of exactly-dated capture days; null when no photo has an exact date.

outliers.description: Photos outside the core run, or dated only approximately.

PhotoAlbumDto.description: One imported event folder or album, summarised for linking to a calendar event.

duplicateOfId.description: On a Duplicate only: the asset that holds the bytes.

purgesAt.description: When the trash is purged of it (`TrashedAt` + retention); null unless trashed.

thumbUrl.description: Presigned GET, long expiry; null until processed.

originalUrl.description: Presigned GET, short expiry; only on the single-asset endpoint.

lastError.description: Only set on a Failed asset — lets the health view explain itself without a per-item fetch.

duplicateOfId.description: On a Duplicate only: the asset that holds the bytes.

purgesAt.description: When the trash is purged of it (`TrashedAt` + retention); null unless trashed.

nextCursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor; absent on the last page.

thumbUrl.description: The photo's, or a cell's newest photo's.

bounds.description: A cell's photo extent, [minLon, minLat, maxLon, maxLat] — where tapping it zooms to.

PhotoMapPropertiesDto.description: One photo when the count is 1, else a grid cell drawn as a count bubble.

PhotoMapResponse.description: GeoJSON-shaped map payload — feeds a MapLibre GeoJSON source directly.

byCamera.description: "Sony G8341" → count; what the importer's camera map is built from.

PlaceCategory.description: Semantic type of a place — drives filtering and iconography. Kept vendor-neutral and coarse; extend as needed.

PlaceDto.description:
A gazetteer place. Coordinates are plain lat/lon on the wire; `Containment` is the AdminArea chain
            outermost→innermost. `DistanceM` is populated only on proximity (`near=`) searches.

PlaceKind.description: What a Place is: a point-of-interest (a named venue/entity) or a plain street address.

PlaceLookupItemDto.description:
`Place` is null when the id is unknown or soft-deleted; on a merge redirect it is the survivor
        (`Place.Id != RequestedId`). Containment is omitted — `GET /places/{id}` remains the detail call.

PlaceResolution.description:
How Place resolution landed: an existing entry matched, a fresh geocode created one, a
            coordinate-less provisional stub was created (address not found), or the geocoder was unreachable so nothing was
            created — the last is retryable and must NOT be mistaken for "not found".

PlaceSource.description: Provenance of a gazetteer entry: created by a user (may be unverified), derived from geocoding, or imported from a gazetteer.

PlaceSuggestionDto.description:
A typeahead suggestion: a gazetteer place (name/alias trigram match) or an AdminArea locality — cities come
            from the GeoNames seed, so they suggest without anyone having geocoded a POI there. `Context` disambiguates
            (formatted address for places, parent area for localities).

PresenceDetail.description:
A presence/availability segment's status; the span is the item itself (whole-day or timed). Replaces the old
            Availability item kind — presence items live on the availability calendar and are exempt from completeness scoring.

PromptFire.description:
Fire timing (flattened union): OnStart/OnEnd carry nothing; Offset uses `OffsetMinutes` (negative = lead time);
            AllDayAt uses `AllDayAt` (local wall-clock time on the occurrence date).

PromptFireKind.description: When a payload fires relative to its item's occurrence.

PromptIntent.description: What an LLM-interpreted run should accomplish.

PruneStatus.description:
Per-place outcome of an orphan prune: soft-deleted (or already was), skipped because something still
            references it, or the id is unknown/merged.

ReachMedium.description: The medium a reach channel uses. Social/IM handles are modeled separately as ContactSocialProfile.

Ref.description: A reference the fired payload acts on. `Id` for Event/Contact/Task; `Url` for External.

RegisterDeviceRequest.description: Register a device that will feed location telemetry.

RegisterDeviceResponse.description:
Result of registering a device. string RegisterDeviceResponse.ApiKey is the one-time plaintext ingest credential
            (`{keyId:N}.{secret}`) — it is shown only here and never retrievable again; only its hash is stored.

RelationProvenance.description: Whether a resolved relation was stored explicitly or derived from the kinship graph.

placeId.description:
Null only when PlaceResolution ResolvePlaceResponse.Resolution is PlaceResolution.GeocodeUnavailable — the
            geocoder was unreachable and nothing was created; the item is retryable.

occurredAt.description:
Client wall-clock of the edit, for last-writer-wins conflict resolution of the core fields.
            Omitted ⇒ server receive time.

ReviseContactRequest.description: Update an existing contact by merge: a provided scalar overwrites, provided reach channels/tags are unioned onto the existing values (deduped), and any field left null keeps its current value. Enrichment never wipes what it didn't mention. Use `PUT /contacts/{id}/channels` to remove channels. The address book isn't changeable here.

SavedPlaceDto.description: A caller's saved place / personal label. References a gazetteer place, or carries a raw coordinate.

SectionGuardDto.description:
One section's last-writer guard: the (occurredAt, commandId) of the write that owns its current
            value. Offline clients seed their local guards from these so a pending edit on one section never blocks —
            and is never clobbered by — fresher server state on another.

SectionGuardsDto.description: Per-section guards for an item: core fields, metadata, the XOR payload, and per-calendar filing.

occurredAt.description: Client wall-clock of the edit, for last-writer-wins conflict resolution. Omitted ⇒ server receive time.

SetContactAddressesRequest.description: Wholesale replacement of a contact's postal addresses; each entry needs a geo place id.

occurredAt.description: Client wall-clock of the edit, for last-writer-wins conflict resolution. Omitted ⇒ server receive time.

SetContactChannelsRequest.description:
Wholesale replacement of a contact's reach channels — emails and phones (empty clears). Unlike
            `ReviseContact`, which only unions, this can remove a channel. Values are trimmed, type tokens lowercased,
            duplicates (by medium + value) dropped; at most one preferred channel per medium.

occurredAt.description: Client wall-clock of the edit, for last-writer-wins conflict resolution. Omitted ⇒ server receive time.

SetContactProfilesRequest.description:
Wholesale replacement of a contact's social/IM handles. For well-known services (telegram, messenger,
            whatsapp…) the profile URL is derived from the handle when omitted.

occurredAt.description: Client wall-clock of the edit, for last-writer-wins conflict resolution. Omitted ⇒ server receive time.

SetContactTagsRequest.description:
Wholesale replacement of a contact's tags (empty clears). Unlike `ReviseContact`,
            which only unions, this can remove a tag. Entries are trimmed and de-duplicated case-insensitively.

occurredAt.description: Client wall-clock of the edit, for last-writer-wins conflict resolution. Omitted ⇒ server receive time.

SetDeceasedRequest.description: Marks a contact as deceased; the date may be unknown.

SetEmergencyContactsRequest.description: Wholesale replacement of a contact's emergency-contact designation; order = priority, empty clears.

occurredAt.description: Client wall-clock of the edit (LWW for the payload section). Omitted ⇒ server receive time.

SetItemActionRequest.description: Set the deterministic payload on an item. Replaces any existing action; rejected (409) if the item carries a prompt.

occurredAt.description: Client wall-clock of the edit (LWW for the payload section). Omitted ⇒ server receive time.

SetItemPromptRequest.description: Set the LLM-interpreted payload on an item. Replaces any existing prompt; rejected (409) if the item carries an action.

SetMyContactRequest.description: Links the caller's identity to its own contact ("this card is me") — the default circles focus.

SuggestionType.description: What a typeahead suggestion points at: a gazetteer SuggestionType.Place or an AdminArea locality.

SyncChangeDto.description: A changed item: the full DTO plus its section guards.

deleted.description:
Ids no longer visible to the caller: soft-deleted, or every accepted membership left the caller's
            readable calendars. Unknown ids are safe to ignore.

SyncChangesResponse.description:
One page of the changes feed. `Cursor` is opaque — hand it back as `?since=`; loop while
            `HasMore`. A full sync (no `since`) streams every live visible item and suppresses tombstones —
            the client replaces its mirror wholesale and rebases pending work.

SyncContainersResponse.description:
Snapshot of the caller's containers. Address books are plain documents (no cursor); groups are
            event-sourced but small and fully replaced each cycle — both are fetched once per sync cycle and diffed
            against the mirror.

TagDto.description: A tag definition on a list.

TakenAtSource.description:
Where DateTimeOffset PhotoAsset.TakenAt came from. TakenAtSource.Device is first so documents
            written before the field existed (phone backups) read as it.

TasksItemStatus.description:
An item's lifecycle position — one state machine, not two flags. ItemStatus.Open, ItemStatus.InProgress,
ItemStatus.Blocked, and ItemStatus.Waiting are open; ItemStatus.Done and ItemStatus.Cancelled are
closed. `Completed` is derived (`Status == Done`). The value is LWW-guarded by one
(OccurredAt, CommandId) guard shared by every lifecycle event, so done-ness and the open sub-state can never
disagree. Lets the assistant answer "what's blocked / waiting on me?".

purpose.description: Curator-written: what the topic is for (the plan, errand, question or outcome).

titled.description: False while string TopicDetailDto.Label is still the provisional first-few-words placeholder.

conversationCount.description: Above 1 the topic spans conversations (a cross-linked matter).

TopicDetailDto.description: A topic with its message window — the open-topic tail (`GET /topics/{id}`).

fromPrincipal.description: True when the owner sent this message — the assistant's inbound-vs-outbound signal.

TopicMessageDto.description: One message in a released topic window (ordered chronologically).

TopicStatus.description: Stored as string; part of the REST/MCP wire contract.

titled.description: False while string TopicSummaryDto.Label is still the provisional first-few-words placeholder.

conversationCount.description: Above 1 the topic spans conversations (a cross-linked matter).

TopicSummaryDto.description: A topic in a list response (the poll alternative — `GET /topics`).

TrackPointDto.description: A point on a (raw or thinned) track.

TransportMode.description:
Mode of a TravelLeg. Rail split: `Train` = mainline/commuter, `Metro` = rapid transit,
            `Tram` = light/narrow-gauge rail; `Coach` = long-distance bus vs local `Bus`.

TravelLeg.description:
One leg of a `Trip`. Mode-agnostic: `DeparturePoint`/`ArrivalPoint` generalize gate/platform/stop,
            `Carrier` the airline/operator, `ServiceNumber` the flight/train/service number. `ToPlaceId`/`FromPlaceId`
            are LupiraGeoApi place ids with denormalized `ToLabel`/`FromLabel`; `DriverContactId` names the driver
            for a TransportMode.Car leg.

toPlaceId.description:
Pre-resolved place ids (places-first imports). When set, used directly instead of resolving
            string? TravelLegRequest.ToPlace/string? TravelLegRequest.FromPlace text; the text, if any, is kept as the label.

TravelLegRequest.description: `ToPlace`/`FromPlace` are free-text labels resolved to a LupiraGeoApi place id + label; `DriverContactId` is a <see cref="!:Contact" /> id.

UpdateAddressBookRequest.description: Update an address book by merge: a provided slug or display name overwrites, null keeps the current value.

placeId.description:
Re-anchor the location to a resolved LupiraGeoApi place; string? UpdateCalendarItemRequest.Location then carries the display
            label. Set bool UpdateCalendarItemRequest.PlaceIdProvided with a null value to clear. Free-text-only location changes are rejected
            (resolve via geo first); CalDAV remains the lenient path.

isAllDay.description: Switch between timed and all-day (null ⇒ kept). All-day items carry their span in StartDate/EndDate.

startTimezone.description: IANA timezone names annotating the timed start/end (not serialized to ICS today).

recurrenceRule.description:
RFC 5545 recurrence rule. Non-null sets it; to CLEAR recurrence send null with
            bool UpdateCalendarItemRequest.RecurrenceRuleProvided = true (a bare null keeps the existing rule).

oneOf.description: Revise the start/end date confidence (see DatePrecision? CreateCalendarItemRequest.StartPrecision). Omitted ⇒ kept.

parentItemId.description: Re-nest under a parent item (or set for the first time). Must exist and be accessible; omitted ⇒ kept.

category.description: Reclassify the item (enum name). Changing the category drops the previous details.

oneOf.description: Change the item's presence segment status.
Composable detail to set/merge: a `Booking` and/or a `Travel` leg; a supplied member replaces that member wholesale.

occurredAt.description:
Client wall-clock of the edit, for last-writer-wins conflict resolution of the core section.
            Omitted ⇒ server receive time (online callers never need it).

UpdateCalendarItemRequest.description:
Core-field update. Two merge conventions coexist: a plain nullable field means "omitted ⇒ kept" (the original
contract, unchanged for existing callers); fields that must also be *clearable* to null carry a paired
`*Provided` sentinel — when the sentinel is true the field's value (including null) is written verbatim.
Offline clients replay whole-section writes, so they set every sentinel and send the full core section.

UpdatePhotoRequest.description: Hand-set metadata. A null contact records the photographer as deliberately unknown.

Cookie.description: Session cookie minted by the BFF's OIDC login.
Cookie.name: __Host-lupira-cal

Bearer.description: Authentik access token from a native client; audience must include lupira-cal.
